bbsvoice.config.title: BBS Voice
bbsvoice.config.bbsvoice.title: BBS Voice
bbsvoice.config.bbsvoice.tooltip: Voice BBS films with Microsoft Edge online speech, or with your own recordings (synthesis needs a network connection)
bbsvoice.config.bbsvoice.default_voice-c: Voice used by freshly created voice tracks
bbsvoice.config.bbsvoice.default_volume-: Volume used by freshly created voice tracks
bbsvoice.config.bbsvoice.default_speed-c: Pace used by freshly created voice tracks
bbsvoice.config.bbsvoice.auto_render-com: Ask Edge to synthesise lines in the background when they are needed
bbsvoice.config.bbsvoice.spatial-comment: Play actor voice tracks in 3D at the actor position instead of as a flat channel
bbsvoice.config.bbsvoice.max_cache_files: How many wav files to keep in config/bbs/assets/audio/bbsvoice
bbsvoice.ui.text.tooltip: What this track says, Chinese and English are both supported
bbsvoice.ui.text.title: Dubbing text
bbsvoice.ui.text.message: Multi line text is allowed, punctuation becomes pauses. Editing the text makes Edge synthesise it again
bbsvoice.ui.voice.tooltip: Opens a searchable voice list: the 26 Edge online voices plus character voices such as Manbo
bbsvoice.ui.offset.tooltip: How many seconds to skip at the start, positive skips ahead
bbsvoice.ui.record.hint: Record with BBS' own microphone UI, the result becomes this track's dubbing
bbsvoice.ui.auto_fit.tooltip: When the utterance is longer than the clip, speed it up until it fits (up to 4x) instead of cutting it off
bbsvoice.ui.curve.tooltip: When enabled the curve can be edited on this track's keyframe timeline, 1.0 means the plain value. Curves are baked into the render, so editing one re-renders it (and needs the network)
bbsvoice.ui.status.cut: clip shorter than the line, so it is cut off - drag the clip's right edge or enable "Fit utterance to clip"
bbsvoice.ui.status.no_rec: Record or pick a file first
